adjudication.rationale: In EventManager.update()’s catch block (near the bottom of the diff), the previously present `console.error(message);` line is removed. The code still builds `message` (and mutates it if `error instanceof Error`) but does not log it or otherwise emit any telemetry before returning failure-shaped results via `Promise.resolve(...)`. So exceptions during update will be converted into failure rows (or an empty array when `calendarReference` ends up `undefined`), with no log signal from this function. This is a concrete, diff-grounded observability regression rather than a direct functional correctness break.
